title: Multiple Joins
seoDescription: Join users, experiment assignments, and conversion events in SQL to report converted users, variants, and revenue.
description:
Join user records, experiment assignments, and conversion events in SQL to compute variant revenue.

Left outer joins preserve all assigned experiment units regardless of whether conversions occurred.

### Query Logic & Formulation
$$
\text{SELECT } u.user\_id, a.variant, \operatorname{COALESCE}(\operatorname{SUM}(c.revenue), 0) \dots
$$

### Relational Execution Steps
1. Inner join users with experiment_assignments
2. Left join with conversion_events on user_id
3. Aggregate revenue per user and variant

### Expected Query Output
Standard SQL query string.
